hero.title: The only job platform that scores every posting for your Express Entry pathway.
hero.subtitle: AI pipeline that tailors your resume, writes your cover letter, and auto-submits — with Canadian PR/NOC scoring on every job.
hero.tagline: The only tool that does quality-tailored autonomous apply, not volume spam.

scoreDemo.title: Senior AI Engineer
scoreDemo.caption: Every imported job is scored like this — PR pathway fit, NOC code, and ATS match — before a single document is generated.

reviewQueue.title: Nothing auto-submits
reviewQueue.body: Tailored resumes and cover letters land in your review queue. You approve or edit each one. A daily send cap limits how many applications leave your account per day.

pathwayScoring.title: Pathway flags on every match
pathwayScoring.body: Each job gets a NOC unit-group code, TEER level, wage vs regional median, and flags for Express Entry categories, provincial streams, and Atlantic program relevance — scored against your work history and permit status.

permitFilters.title: Built for work-permit holders
permitFilters.body: You set your permit type and expiry during onboarding. Jobs requiring LMIA, security clearance, or citizenship you do not hold are filtered out before they appear in your feed.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Four steps from discovery to send — with you in control at the end.

discover.title: Discover
discover.body: Run discovery against Job Bank and other sources. Jobs that fail your work-authorization or permit filters never enter your feed.

score.title: Score for your pathway
score.body: Each match shows NOC/TEER, wage vs regional median, and pathway flags (EE, PNP, AIP) derived from published program criteria and your profile.

tailor.title: Tailor
tailor.body: Generate a Canadian-format resume and cover letter for a role. No photo, no SIN — formatting rules are enforced automatically.

approve.title: You approve
approve.body: Review the draft in your queue. Only after you approve does an application move toward send — subject to your plan's daily cap.

jobExample.title: What a match looks like
jobExample.subtitle: The same badges you see on the jobs feed — NOC, TEER, wage vs median, and pathway flags.
jobExample.label: Example match

pricing.title: Free to start, Pro when you need more sends
pricing.subtitle: Both plans use the same review queue. Pro raises your daily send cap and removes the monthly tailoring limit.
